project_info.theme: Adult fashion portrait emerging from a freshly developed instant photo
project_info.creative_direction: Photoreal forced-perspective composite with physical print texture and readable outfit annotations
project_info.color_palette: warm autumn brown, cream, beige knitwear, dark leather brown, white photo border, and muted cafe tones

main_subject.type: clearly adult woman matching the approved portrait reference
main_subject.detail: adult woman with long loose wavy hair, playful confident eyes, natural skin texture, and slight wind movement
main_subject.wardrobe: high-neck knit turtleneck, mini skirt, and leather boots
main_subject.pose: upper torso and head rising out of a glossy instant photo, one hand slightly forward as if stepping into reality, with a closed-lip playful smile

composition_elements.framing: top-down three-quarter close POV with the instant photo and face sharp against cafe bokeh
composition_elements.illusion: full outfit visible inside the print while the head and upper body emerge above it, casting a real shadow onto the table
composition_elements.props: glossy Polaroid-style print with fingerprint smudges and micro-scratches, espresso cup, fallen leaves, stone pavement, and distant pedestrians
composition_elements.annotations: legible non-mirrored handwritten labels leather boots, clean turtleneck, and mini skirt with arrows pointing to the printed outfit; fictional caption OOTD ESCAPE - PARIS

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: soft overcast daylight at approximately 5600K with gentle cafe bounce
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: natural print shadow, subtle glossy reflections, autumn cafe warmth, and realistic paper texture

technical_specs.render_style: full-frame camera with 90mm macro lens, photoreal forced-perspective composite
technical_specs.finish: shallow depth of field, natural skin texture, visible paper scratches, restrained grain, and no CGI gloss

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a hyper-realistic optical-illusion photograph using the approved adult portrait reference. The clearly adult woman appears to emerge from a freshly developed Polaroid-style instant photo lying on a small Paris sidewalk cafe table in autumn. In the glossy print, show her full outfit: a high-neck knit turtleneck, mini skirt, and leather boots; in reality, her upper body and head rise out of the print, casting a real shadow onto the table. Give her long loose waves with realistic shine and slight wind movement, playful confident eyes, and a closed-lip playful smile while one hand reaches slightly forward as if stepping into reality. Add fingerprint smudges and micro-scratches to the print, an espresso cup, fallen leaves, stone pavement, and soft distant pedestrian bokeh. Add readable, non-mirrored white handwritten annotations leather boots, clean turtleneck, and mini skirt with arrows to the printed outfit, plus the fictional caption OOTD ESCAPE - PARIS. Use a top-down three-quarter angle, 90mm macro lens, soft approximately 5600K overcast daylight, real contact shadows, and photoreal texture rather than CGI.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, ambiguous age, pout, blowing a kiss, childlike styling, 3d render, cartoon, anime, plastic skin, illegible text, mirrored text, watermark, oversharpened halos, uncanny face, extra fingers, deformed hands, fake glossy CGI print
